lesson.title: Practice: Song-style: Horse With No Name
lesson.one_line_promise: Drill the Em / D loop until automatic.
objectives: Run 1-minute change counts on every adjacent pair in the loop

chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

Em.name: E minor
Em.note: Verified deterministically by chord-theory-check.js (2026-08-08) as E B G.

D.name: D major
D.note: Verified deterministically by chord-theory-check.js (2026-08-08) as D A F#.

exercises.name: Warm-up: spider + Chord-Perfect
exercises.purpose: Warm the hand, lock each voicing.
exercises.coaching: Spider to warm up, then Chord-Perfect each chord in the loop.

exercises.name: 1-minute changes — Em <-> D
exercises.coaching: Em to D, back and forth, as many clean changes as you can in a minute.

exercises.name: 1-minute changes — D <-> Em
exercises.coaching: D to Em, back and forth, as many clean changes as you can in a minute.

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: Drill the loop behind "Horse With No Name".
avatar_coaching_copy.results: Higher count than last time = learning.
